newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil publishes terms of railway concession.
newsitem.headline: Brazil publishes terms of railway concession.

text.p: Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) published Monday the terms and conditions for the 30-year concession of the Southern Railway, a 4,100 mile (6,600 kms) network which connects Brazil to Argentina and Uruguay.
Under the terms published in the Official Gazette (Diario Oficial), the Southern Railway Network concession will be auctioned on December 13 at a base price of 158 million reais ($154 million).
The winning bidder will be required to pay 20 percent of the total amount cash down. The balance will be paid after a two-year grace period in 112 quarterly installments.

The Southern Railway runs through some of Brazil's most propserous territory in the states of Parana, Santa Catarina and Rio Grande do Sul carrying grains, oil and alcohol. Last year, it transported 13.6 million tonnes of freight.

Generally referred to as the "Mercosur Railway", its concession has sparked considerable interest among investors who see huge opportunities in transporting goods between Brazil, Uruguay and Argentina, all partners in a free trade pact.
According to news reports, interested investors include meat packers Sadia and Perdigao, Argentina's Grupo Pescarmona, and the Noel Group, which recently won the Western Network concession.
The Southern Railway concession will be the fifth of six sections of Brazil's railway network to be auctioned under the National Privatization Program.
